samples.stimulus: The table shows the amount of data received for several values of the number of minutes a video has been downloading. The relationship between the two quantities is linear. The conversion between units is given above the table.
samples.question: By how many megabytes does the amount of data received increase for each increase of 1 second in the number of minutes a video has been downloading, when the number of minutes a video has been downloading is measured in seconds?
samples.explanation: (1) 표에서 두 행 (15, 201) 과 (20, 261) 을 읽는다. (2) 기울기 = (261 - 201) ÷ (20 - 15) = 12 이다. (3) 1 minute = 60 seconds 이다. (4) 작은 단위 1 당 변화 = 12 ÷ 60 = 0.2 이다. (5) 따라서 0.2 megabytes 씩 증가한다. 따라서 정답은 0.2이다.
